# group_membership

A view. Current membership keyed by group_name — the view to query for membership.

## Columns

`group_name`, `group_id`, `identity_id`.

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE VIEW group_membership AS
SELECT g.name AS group_name, m.group_id, m.identity_id
FROM group_members m
JOIN groups g ON g.id = m.group_id;
```
